ui.name: tags-input
ui.summary: Renders a comma-separated text field with suggestions.
ui.guidance: The value is one text field, so it submits and round-trips with no JavaScript, and the server parses the separator. A chip widget that keeps its real value in hidden inputs loses everything the moment the script fails to load, and cannot be edited with a keyboard without a custom keymap.
